title: Super Bust-A-Move
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Shoot bubbles; match 3 to pop them
Taito's Puzzle Bobble: fire bubbles from the launcher; 3 or more of a color pop
Bubbles no longer connected to the ceiling fall and score extra

Unconnected bubbles fall; the ceiling lowers over time
Two rule sets in the ROM: "Super Puzzle Bobble" mode and "Puzzle Bobble Classic" mode
The ceiling drops after a number of shots: clear space before it does
Bank shots off walls; drop big groups for points

rows: big drops send garbage bubbles to the opponent

widgets.text: Bank shots off the side walls reach bubbles hidden behind others

Puzzle, VS, Challenge
Story mode is a journey: places like the edge of space, the God of Luck and a city of golden colour
Next-round screen between stages; mode select on the title screen
Special bubbles (e.g. rainbow, star) appear in later stages

Levels cleared
Stages cleared on the journey; endings vary with the route

Stages
Rounds cleared per mode; the journey ends back at home
